script: Dinosaurs other than birds lived for about 165 million years. The first dinosaurs appeared around 230 million years ago. Many early dinosaurs were small and fast. Their age is split into the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous periods. Modern humans have been around for only about 300,000 years. So far, dinosaurs have lasted over 500 times longer than we have.
